build_sentencepiece_tokenizer: build a SentencePieceBackend tokenizer from a sentencepiece.model file for text tokenization
add_tokens_to_vocab: add new tokens to the SentencePieceBackend vocabulary with optional special token handling
tokenize_text_with_sp: tokenize a text string using the SentencePieceBackend _tokenize method with legacy mode support
extract_vocab_from_sp_model: extract vocabulary ids, scores, and merges from a SentencePieceExtractor trained model
decode_token_ids_to_string: decode a list of token ids back to a human-readable string using SentencePieceBackend
